stories.headline: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force undergoes major organizational restructuring
stories.summary: The JMSDF on March 23 disbanded its long-standing 'Fleet Escort Force' and established a new 'Fleet Surface Force' in its most significant organizational overhaul since 1954. The restructuring aims to improve decision-making and ship operations for remote island defense against China.

stories.headline: LDP abandons hopes for fiscal 2026 budget passage by end of fiscal year
stories.summary: Liberal Democratic Party officials informed opposition counterparts they are abandoning hopes of passing the fiscal 2026 budget by March 31. The Diet passed a provisional budget on March 30, with some LDP members now eyeing April 7 for final passage.

articles.title: LDP gives up on last-minute approval for fiscal 2026 plan

stories.headline: LDP acknowledges still 'halfway' to regaining public trust in 2026 policy platform
stories.summary: The Liberal Democratic Party's 2026 policy platform draft states the party is still only halfway to restoring trust following the slush funds scandal. The platform outlines Prime Minister Takaichi's fiscal and economic policies while acknowledging ongoing work to rebuild party credibility.

articles.title: LDP Still Halfway to Regaining Trust: Draft Policy Platform
